title: 边境山脉
description:
Introduction of the Team

Об игреTraditional JRPG game, experience a fantasy story! More interesting adventures await you to discover surprises and encounters.

The “Border Mountains” is the first work developed by Hercules Game Studio. The game features classic role-playing and turn-based combat. Defeat enemies on your journey and uncover the truth of the world!

Experience the combat strategies brought by different professions and skills. Every battle is different because of your decisions!

Set off from the foot of the mountain, explore the dangerous wilderness and cave mazes, unravel the traps set by enemies!

Delve into the shadows of the mountains, discover the truth of the story, and defeat powerful bosses!

Face different enemies and challenges with the protagonist team during the adventure, and grow together with them!"
description_short: "Border Mountain" tells the story of four adventurers at the Herac Camp, who embark on their adventure after a war between the Imperial Army and the legion of monsters. Players will journey with them through snowy mountains, explore mysterious caves, and ultimately find their own path of adventure.
